These straightforward disclosures about monthly internet bills – a consumer transparency effort I've long championed – are one step closer to reality. They’ll help working families avoid hidden fees and know exactly what they’re paying for. 
https://t.co/f5MvUAJPuP

Transparency in internet pricing can help ensure that Minnesotans know what they’re getting from their provider. Happy to see the Administration taking this step, for which I introduced legislation in Congress. https://t.co/qTTaWGf0V0

Devin was an honors student at Hastings High School who loved football & making music. In 2020, he died in his sleep from a fentanyl overdose.
 
The fentanyl crisis is devastating MN families and communities. It’s time to put partisan theatrics aside and get to work. https://t.co/XLhuNaBfzZ

It’s essential that Congress acts swiftly to keep our communities safe from the dangers of fentanyl.
 
I’m pushing for more additional law enforcement resources, expanded access to naloxone & I’ll keep working to help protect our communities.

https://t.co/SfZ5Th2Buj

This year, the House Ag Committee will write the Farm Bill, which sets nutrition & agriculture policy for years to come.
 
I’ll be putting the voices of #MN02 producers & farmers front & center as we write this bill. It’s important we get this right.

Welcome to #MN02, Doc! 🐾
https://t.co/PhXKQ6wGJv

#MN02 firefighters put their lives on the line in service of our community & it’s important we have their backs.
 
Great to talk with Eagan Fire Chief Hugo Searle & MNFire about how we can improve firefighter health & wellness. Looking forward to our continued work together! https://t.co/n22Y6XHVDz

If the work we’re doing in Minnesota to fight the opioid crisis can save even one life or one family, it will be worth it.
 
I’ll keep doing everything I can to give more Minnesotans a chance at treatment and recovery & get illicit fentanyl off our streets. https://t.co/0azzsuDGnx

Republicans are using a government shutdown to push for cuts to funding for low-income child care and nutrition assistance programs & restrict our reproductive freedoms.

Extreme MAGA Republicans need to stop the political games so we can stop a reckless shutdown and do our jobs.

For Minnesotans struggling with substance use disorder, treatment courts are a way to help get non-violent offenders the support they need to recover & rehabilitate.

We’re announcing nearly $800K for Rice County’s Treatment Court. I’ll keep working to bring money back to MN. https://t.co/aF8oeOblkh

The stories I’ve heard from #MN02 residents and letter carriers regarding mail service are unacceptable. Enough is enough. We need change.

I’ll keep working to hold USPS leadership accountable for the mail service and their treatment of postal workers.

https://t.co/Hmx1z6scsA

According to @HHSgov, out of the 48 million Americans who experienced a substance use disorder in 2022, three out of every four did not receive treatment.

We’ve got to do better.

I’ll keep working to ensure that all Americans have access to the resources & treatment they need.

I secured over $80,000 for Shakopee PD to help support officers’ mental health & wellness.
 
I’ll keep working to ensure local law enforcement officers have the resources they need to lead healthy lives as they work hard to keep our communities safe.
 
https://t.co/vaW9jY5lNP

Today in @EnergyCommerce, we're discussing the use of AI technology in our health care systems.

AI has the potential to improve treatment for patients but it poses a threat to patient privacy.

We must place the necessary guardrails on AI technology to ensure patients’ security. https://t.co/v2KUPsk72F
Last night I tested positive for Covid — I’m experiencing mild symptoms. I’ll be isolating in DC and will continue working remotely from there this week.

The fentanyl crisis continues to devastate families across our nation. I’ve been working to find bipartisan solutions, but Congress needs to do more.

That means expanding treatment access, supporting law enforcement & holding drug traffickers accountable.
https://t.co/tZA2uFQhkQ

Unions fight hard to secure better working conditions, higher wages and fair treatment for American workers – and our economy is stronger for it.
 
I’ll always fight to protect your right to organize and collectively bargain.

Today I met with Emily Malone, the Child Nutrition Director for Prior Lake Savage Area Schools, in my DC office to discuss how we can work together to improve child nutrition programs in Minnesota & ensure all our students have access to healthy foods.
 
Thanks for stopping by! https://t.co/q67TYu8Mui

No one should have to forego necessary medical care because they cannot afford treatment or risk going into debt.

I’m pushing the Administration to expand access to essential health care services & ensure every American can access the health care coverage they need. https://t.co/2rj4MYfMIJ

I’m in Northfield to recognize the nearly $4 million dollars in federal funding I secured with Mayor Rhonda Pownell for the construction of a new Water Treatment Facility, which will help ensure Minnesotans can access clean, safe drinking water. https://t.co/rKFKbEVbaV

During Mental Health Awareness Month & every month, I’m working to ensure access to affordable mental health care & substance use disorder recovery treatment is available to the folks who need them.

If you or someone you know is in crisis, call or text 9-8-8. You are not alone.

Passing a bipartisan Farm Bill should be the number one priority of the Ag Committee.

That’s why I’ve worked across the aisle on 12 pieces of legislation to help strengthen the Farm Bill.

But the GOP's $320 million in cuts to Minnesota nutrition funding is a nonstarter for me.

I worked with Northfield Mayor Rhonda Pownell to secure nearly $4 million in federal funding for the construction of a new water treatment facility for the city of Northfield, which will help ensure more Minnesotans can access safe, clean drinking water.

https://t.co/C1m5tupG95

I worked with Le Sueur Mayor Shawn Kirby and local leaders to secure nearly $1 million in federal funds to increase the treatment capacity of Le Sueur’s water treatment facility.

I’ll keep working to make investments that ensure Minnesotans can access clean, safe drinking water. https://t.co/oKViSk81CM

I worked with Le Sueur Mayor Shawn Kirby to secure over $950,000 to expand the capacity of the city’s water treatment facility and ensure more rural Minnesotans can access clean drinking water.

https://t.co/ZsyAoB6R6f
